definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Aspect of the Moon
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: Pact of the Tome. You don't need sleep and can't be magically put to sleep; a long rest can be 8 hours of light activity.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Bond of the Talisman
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 12th level, Pact of the Talisman. As an action, teleport to the talisman's wearer (or they to you), proficiency bonus times per long rest.

actions.name: Bond of the Talisman
actions.note: Teleport to the unoccupied space closest to the talisman's wearer, on the same plane.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Cloak of Flies
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level. Bonus action: a 5-ft aura of flies until you're incapacitated or dismiss it. Advantage on Intimidation, disadvantage on other Charisma checks; creatures starting their turn in it take poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier. Once per short rest.

actions.name: Cloak of Flies
actions.note: Creatures that start their turn in the aura take poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Eldritch Mind
definitions.summary: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentrating on a spell.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Eldritch Smite
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of the Blade. Once per turn when your pact weapon hits, spend a warlock slot: +1d8 force, plus 1d8 per slot level, and you can knock a Huge or smaller target prone.

when.text: with your pact weapon; spends a warlock slot

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Far Scribe
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of the Tome. Creatures write their names in your Book of Shadows (up to your proficiency bonus); you can cast sending to them without a slot or components.

spells.name: Sending
spells.casting: without a slot, to a creature named in your book

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Ghostly Gaze
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 7th level. As an action, see through solid objects to 30 ft (with darkvision) for 1 minute, concentrating. Once per short rest.

actions.name: Ghostly Gaze
actions.note: See through solid objects within 30 ft for 1 minute (concentration).

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Depths
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level. Breathe underwater and swim at your walking speed; cast water breathing once per long rest without a slot.

resources.name: Gift of the Depths: Water Breathing

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.casting: once per long rest, without a slot

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: Pact of the Chain. While your familiar is within 100 ft, healing dice you roll for yourself count as their maximum.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Protectors
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 9th level, Pact of the Tome. A creature named in your Book of Shadows that drops to 0 hit points drops to 1 instead, once per long rest.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Grasp of Hadar
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: eldritch blast. Once per turn when eldritch blast hits, pull the creature 10 ft straight toward you.

modifiers.label: Grasp of Hadar: once per turn, pull a creature hit 10 ft toward you.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Improved Pact Weapon
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade. Your pact weapon can be your spellcasting focus, gets +1 to attack and damage if it has no bonus, and can be a shortbow, longbow or crossbow.

when.text: with your pact weapon (no magic bonus of its own)
with your pact weapon (no magic bonus of its own)

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Investment of the Chain Master
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: Pact of the Chain. Your familiar flies or swims 40 ft, attacks as magical, uses your save DC; as a bonus action you command it to attack; as a reaction you give it resistance to damage.

actions.name: Command familiar to attack
actions.note: Your familiar takes the Attack action.

actions.name: Familiar resistance
actions.note: When your familiar takes damage, it has resistance to it.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Lance of Lethargy
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: eldritch blast. Once per turn when eldritch blast hits, reduce the creature's speed by 10 ft until the end of your next turn.

modifiers.label: Lance of Lethargy: once per turn, a creature hit loses 10 ft of speed until the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Maddening Hex
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level, hex or a curse feature. Bonus action: psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to the cursed target and creatures you choose within 5 ft of it.

actions.name: Maddening Hex

roll.label: psychic damage to the cursed target and your choice of creatures within 5 ft of it

actions.note: The cursed target must be within 30 ft and visible.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Protection of the Talisman
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 7th level, Pact of the Talisman. The wearer adds a d4 to a failed saving throw, proficiency bonus times per long rest.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Rebuke of the Talisman
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: Pact of the Talisman. Reaction when the wearer is hit by an attacker within 30 ft you can see: psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and push it 10 ft.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Relentless Hex
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 7th level, hex or a curse feature. Bonus action: teleport up to 30 ft to a space within 5 ft of the target you cursed.

actions.name: Relentless Hex
actions.note: Teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see within 5 ft of your cursed target.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Shroud of Shadow
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 15th level. Cast invisibility at will, without a slot.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Tomb of Levistus
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level. Reaction when you take damage: encase yourself in ice for 10 temporary HP per warlock level, then vulnerable to fire, speed 0 and incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

actions.name: Tomb of Levistus
actions.note: Then: vulnerable to fire, speed 0 and incapacitated until the ice melts at the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Trickster's Escape
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 7th level. Cast freedom of movement on yourself once per long rest without a slot.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.casting: once per long rest, on yourself, without a slot

definitions.name: Eldritch Invocation: Undying Servitude
definitions.summary: Prerequisite: 5th level. Cast animate dead once per long rest without a slot.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.casting: once per long rest, without a slot

definitions.name: Pact of the Talisman
definitions.summary: An amulet: its wearer adds a d4 to a failed ability check, proficiency bonus times per long rest.
